fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: When the service is executed, this field will be filled out by the system with a message in the terminology of the user and language that describes the successful completion of the service, or describes the error condition if there was an error.  The text for completion messages is stored in labels and can be customized per user if necessary.

fields.Name: ESigRequirement
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The signature requirement for the spec/service combination.  Only one should be defined for the combination.

fields.Name: Factory
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The factory where the work was performed.  The container must exist in the factory specified here.  Usually this field is not input by the user.

fields.Name: HistoryId
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The history object (Container, Event, ProcessObject, etc) to map the value to the HistorySummary table.

fields.Name: IsRemoteService
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

fields.Name: MfgOrder
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
A Manufacturing Order is a request to manufacture a product. Manufacturing orders are typically originated to fulfill a sales order or inventory requirements and are often a link between MES and an ERP system. 

A Manufacturing Order can contain a list of product containers. The relationship of a container to a manufacturing order is established and maintained in the containers data record. This information is used to provide WIP status by manufacturing order and WIP updates to the ERP system.

fields.Name: MfgProcessOverrides
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

fields.Name: ProcessESignatures
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Identifies whether the Electronic Signatures should be validated and executed for the service.  This is used to turn off the processing in the subservices when they are called from a compound (the Electronic Signature processing should take place in the compound).

fields.Name: TrackableObject
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The trackable object (Container, Event, ProcessObject, etc) to run the service for.

fields.Name: ActionSource
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to filter Actions.

fields.Name: AdditionalESigReqs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Contains the list of ESignature Requirements that should be collected in a single transaction.

fields.Name: AlertMsgList
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A string list used holds the additional messages of a transaction

fields.Name: AlertMsgListDelimiter
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A string field used to define the delimiter string to separate the additional messages

fields.Name: CalledByTransactionTask
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: If this transaction is being performed as part of an e-procedure, this is the TransactionTask where it was specified.

fields.Name: DataCollectionDef
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The Data Collection Definition used to define the parametric data fields to collect and place in ParametricData.  If there is only one reference to this specific service in the Spec TransactionMap, InSite will fill in this field automatically.  If a service exists multiple times in the TransactionMap, the user will need to input which data collection definition they are using.  For instance, the CollectData service might be entered twice on the TransactionMap, once with parameters recorded every hour, and once with parameters recorded every ten minutes.  When the user is performing the ColllectData, the user would then need to specify which kind of data collection they are performing in this field.

fields.Name: DispatchItem
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Facilitates the configuration of dispatching rules for MfgOrders and Containers on Shopfloor services.  Only one entry per dispatch item type will be allowed to be configured.

fields.Name: DispatchRule
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field represents the existence of an order dispatch type within the dispatch rule, used in the enforcement of the Dispatch Rule.

fields.Name: EffectivityDate
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This date/time is used in a comparison against EffectiveDates in modeling entities to help determine if the object should be considered for processing.  This value is always specified as GMT time.

fields.Name: EmailGroup
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Fields that can be used to identify the EmailGroup to send an email to. Some transactions allow the user to set the EmailGroup to send to such as LotHold and LotRelease.

fields.Name: Employee
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The user who will get credit for the work performed.  Not necessarily the user who is logging the transaction.

fields.Name: EnableRPT
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A flag to determine whether the service will trigger the RPT calculation.

fields.Name: EnforceDispatch
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Boolean flag to override dispatch enforcement.

fields.Name: HasDataCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Returns true if the associated service has a data collection assigned, false otherwise.

fields.Name: HasDPCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine if the data collection type is of type DataPointCollection.

fields.Name: HasUserDataCollection
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This flag allows the client to determine the type of data collection to process, UserDataCollection or ParametricDataCollection.

fields.Name: IsExternalAppTxnExecution
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The flag indicates whether a transaction was initiated by an external application, such as through a REST API call. This field is crucial for managing data broadcasts, like controlling a SignalR broadcast. By default, the flag is set to false, allowing normal broadcasting of data. However, when the flag is set to true, it serves as a control mechanism to prevent broadcasting the transaction data. This indicates that the transaction was executed externally, and therefore, should not be broadcast back.

fields.Name: MfgCalendar
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Calendar that is used to translate the timestamp of when a transaction was performed into a specific manufacturing date and shift.

fields.Name: ParametricDataControl
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: FileName - used for fields that specify files.

fields.Name: ParametricDataDefType
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: CDO Definition Id

fields.Name: Password
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: NT login password for the user performing the service, if "User" was entered.  If "user" is not entered security is based on the InSite login.

fields.Name: PrintingResult
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Printing Result

fields.Name: PrintLabels
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Generic Boolean

fields.Name: PrintQueue
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Printers InSite can use to print labels.

fields.Name: ProcessActiveMfgOrder
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field is a flag to enable the processing of active mfg orders, which will validate the resources' active mfg orders with the process container mfg orders.

fields.Name: ProcessEProcedures
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Electronic Procedures processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessMaintMgmt
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Maintenance Management processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessMasterRecipe
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the Master Recipe processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessNCRs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field provides a way to turn off all the NCRs processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

fields.Name: ProcessResourceStatusModel
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Flag used to find and execute a StatusModelDetail with a PreconditionToAutoSet that returns true.

fields.Name: ProcessTrainingReqs
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
This field provides a way to turn off all the Training Requirements processing (validations and executions) in a single place.
Note that this is addition to the CheckTrainingReqs flag. The ProcessTrainingReqs will be used to turn off the feature globally, while the CheckTrainingReqs is used to control it at the individual service level.

fields.Name: RemainingProcessTime
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Remaining Process Time value, used for RPT calculation.

fields.Name: SampleQty
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Sample Qty

fields.Name: SamplingPlan
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product.  The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

fields.Name: SamplingPlanDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The specific describes the details for a Sampling Plan's Sample Test..  For each  Sample Test, the AQL Level, Inspection Level, Switching Rule, Spec, Vendor and Resoruce can be configured.  Resolved from the Container

fields.Name: SpecFilter
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This field is getting from Line Assignment and its meant to be used as a filter parameter for shopfloor queries.

fields.Name: ss_SPCRecipe
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: A subclass of Document describes recipe.

fields.Name: TaskContainer
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: If this service is being performed as part of a e-procedure task, this is the container for which the e-procedure is being processed. This field is used top populate the ExecuteTaskService.Container field, and for ContainerTxns, this will be the same as the Container field. It is needed for the case where the service is not a Container Transaction, e.g. ResourceSetup.

fields.Name: TaskTime
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Time it took to perform the task

fields.Name: TrainingRequirements
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Definition of the training required before a user is allowed to perform a specific task

fields.Name: TxnDate
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The date and time the service was performed.  If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

fields.Name: TxnParentServiceName
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The name of the parent service that calls a subservice.

fields.Name: TxnServiceSequence

CdoId: 4650; FieldId: 3956; Workspace: csi; Flags: None; Annotations: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite.

maxQueueTimeAction.description:
CdoId: 4650; FieldId: 3957; Workspace: csi; Flags: None; Annotations: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite.

This value is used to determine the action to take when a Service (transaction) is started for a Container that has been in-queue longer than the allowable queue time (MaxQueueTime). 

The values for this option are:
0 = No action
1 = Warning to Operator
2 = Warning to Operator requiring a password to continue
3 = Place container on Hold
4 = Do not allow transaction to continue

These values and their associated actions are intended to match the values and actions for field validations.

This action applies to any service that changes a Container from an In-Queue to an In-Process state.
